host_validation.result: passed; actual buildReply asserted exact 101-bit complete stream including five lead clock lows

bench_status: Flash verified twice; owner displayed R6IECA9S8EN0001 on both runs. Both captures contain 101 D2 rises; repeat D3 sample sequence matches the first 06 capture. Yellow low was 918.0 us initially and 918.4 us on repeat, starting about 8.22 ms, before the emitted frame ends. Byte review: LINK_STATUS=8Eh set bit 2, so firmware performed the optional terminal INI read; status bit 3 remained set and selected the existing error branch. N0001 is consistent with one such read for an ordinary small descriptor. This does not identify the byte read or establish frame acceptance. Final matched-control run also flash-verified this image; owner displayed R6IECADS8EN0001. Its 101-cell capture matches the earlier 06 waveform, with yellow low 918us at 8.212ms. Readout: CPU A=ECh, F=ADh, terminal LINK_STATUS=8Eh, N0001. LINK_STATUS bit 2 is set, selecting the optional terminal INI read; LINK_STATUS bit 3 remains set and the same error path follows. The one-read count is consistent with an ordinary small descriptor, but neither the byte value nor frame acceptance is known.
